title: Yesterday at the funfair
grammar: past simple: went / saw / had / rode / won

scene.speaker: valentina
scene.bubble: Guess what! Yesterday the Fjord Club went to the funfair — and Mateo lost his ticket TWICE!
scene.intro: Yesterday the funfair came to town, with its big wheel, its ring game and its mountain of popcorn! The Fjord Club went at ten o'clock and stayed all day. Mateo lost his ticket TWO times, Erik won a little green dragon, and everyone screamed on the big wheel. Today they can't stop talking about it — in the past! Went, saw, ate, rode, won: these are the words of a great story. Come and hear it!

activities.title: Listen. Valentina tells the story of the funfair. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.script: Sofia: Tell me everything, Valentina! … Valentina: Well, we went to the funfair at ten o'clock. First, Mateo lost his ticket in the bus! … Sofia: Oh no! What did he do? … Valentina: The driver found it under a seat. Then we rode the big wheel — it was very high! … Sofia: Did you eat anything? … Valentina: Yes, we ate popcorn and Erik had a big red ice cream. … Sofia: And the games? … Valentina: Erik won a prize at the ring game — a little green dragon! … Sofia: What about Mateo's ticket? … Valentina: He lost it again at the door… but this time it was in his pocket all the time!

pairs.right: At ten o'clock in the morning.

pairs.right: Mateo — but the driver found it!

pairs.left: How many times did you ride the big wheel?
